profile.name: Dr. Harish Kumar
profile.title: Chairperson Research | Assistant Professor (Marketing)
profile.institution: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon
profile.tagline: Pioneering the intersection of Spatial Computing (XR/AR/VR), Generative AI, and Consumer Psychology.
profile.bio: I am a dedicated academician with a keen research interest in XR (AR, VR) and Gen AI in Marketing. Adept at both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, I combine rigorous theoretical frameworks and cutting-edge empirical methods to decode consumer behavior in immersive digital environments. My publication record includes 15 ABDC-A*/A journal articles, alongside an active research pipeline targeting elite Financial Times (FT-50) journals.
profile.address: Chand Colony, Dharuhera, Distt: Rewari (Haryana), PIN – 123106

researchPillars.title: Spatial Computing & XR in Marketing
researchPillars.summary: Investigating how Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) reshape retail decision-making, consumer engagement, immersive presence, and cognitive load.

researchPillars.title: Generative AI & Consumer Behavior
researchPillars.summary: Examining consumer perception, algorithmic trust, and expectancy-disconfirmation when interacting with generative AI, including when high AI output quality paradoxically backfires.

researchPillars.title: Inclusive Marketing & Well-Being
researchPillars.summary: Exploring technology as a benefit equalizer for marginalized groups, identity stigmatization, and inclusive service ecosystems for consumers with disabilities.

researchPillars.title: Advanced Methodologies
researchPillars.summary: Multi-method rigor spanning Laddering & Means-End Chain across multi-country samples, experimental design, PLS-SEM, AMOS, grounded theory, and systematic reviews.

lab.name: Spatial Reality Lab
lab.institution: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon
lab.description: The Spatial Reality Lab is a pioneering academic innovation center dedicated to the empirical investigation of Extended Reality (XR), Spatial Computing, and Generative Artificial Intelligence in marketing. The lab serves as an advanced testing ground for immersive VR setups, mobile AR experimental platforms, and cross-cultural user studies, partnering with international researchers and industry leaders.

academicExperience.institution: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon
points: Introduced pioneering course on 'Spatial Computing in Marketing' to PGPM students with stellar evaluations.
Founded the Spatial Reality Lab – an experimental hub for XR consumer research and technology-driven industry partnerships.
Launched the 'Discovery Dialogue Series', bringing global marketing scholars for interdisciplinary research symposia.
Founded the 'TARD Workshop Series' to train teaching assistants in advanced research methodologies and scholarly publishing.
Steering the institution's overall research strategy, doctoral initiatives, and faculty scholarly output.
Delivered and assisted in 30-hour course under Prof. Rohit Prasad for PGPM students, earning 'Excellent' remarks.
Coached over 500 UGC NET-JRF aspirants in Commerce and Management with record-breaking qualifying outcomes.
Received institutional recognition for creative classroom lesson plans, interactive pedagogy, and instructional techniques.
